items.details: Use the original PC setup to check movement, vehicle entry, braking and weapon selection before attempting a timed contract. If the whole game runs too quickly, the original frame limiter can be toggled with F8; do not interpret an accelerated timer as the intended difficulty. Practice a short circuit near the starting area and confirm that you can stop beside a phone without overshooting it. This guide does not require a modified control scheme or emulator save-state feature.

details_i18n.en: Use the original PC setup to check movement, vehicle entry, braking and weapon selection before attempting a timed contract. If the whole game runs too quickly, the original frame limiter can be toggled with F8; do not interpret an accelerated timer as the intended difficulty. Practice a short circuit near the starting area and confirm that you can stop beside a phone without overshooting it. This guide does not require a modified control scheme or emulator save-state feature.
details_i18n.pt: Confira no programa de configuração original os comandos de movimento, entrada em veículos, frenagem e seleção de armas antes de tentar um contrato cronometrado. Se o jogo inteiro estiver rápido demais, o limitador original pode ser alternado com F8; não trate um cronômetro acelerado como a dificuldade prevista. Pratique um pequeno circuito perto do início e confirme que consegue parar junto a um telefone sem ultrapassá-lo. Este guia não exige comandos modificados nem salvamento de estado de emulador.

items.details: F7 recalls the latest pager message, F10 repeats the latest ordinary message and F9 redisplays the current district name in the original PC controls. Read the destination and any required vehicle or passenger before moving. The objective arrow indicates direction, not a navigable road route: a river, railway or building can lie between you and the target. Use the city map to choose a bridge or access road, then check the area name again after arriving. Rereading the message is safer than guessing from a disappearing line of text.

details_i18n.en: F7 recalls the latest pager message, F10 repeats the latest ordinary message and F9 redisplays the current district name in the original PC controls. Read the destination and any required vehicle or passenger before moving. The objective arrow indicates direction, not a navigable road route: a river, railway or building can lie between you and the target. Use the city map to choose a bridge or access road, then check the area name again after arriving. Rereading the message is safer than guessing from a disappearing line of text.
details_i18n.pt: Nos comandos originais de PC, F7 repete a última mensagem do pager, F10 repete a última mensagem comum e F9 mostra novamente o bairro atual. Leia o destino e qualquer veículo ou passageiro exigido antes de partir. A seta indica a direção, não uma rota viária: rios, trilhos ou prédios podem separar você do alvo. Use o mapa para escolher uma ponte ou via de acesso e confira novamente o bairro ao chegar. Reler a mensagem é mais seguro que adivinhar por uma linha de texto que desapareceu.

title_i18n.en: Learn the score and Bonus Multiplier

items.description: Watch how successful jobs change the value of later scoring actions.

description_i18n.en: Watch how successful jobs change the value of later scoring actions.
description_i18n.pt: Observe como trabalhos bem-sucedidos alteram o valor das ações que rendem pontos depois.

items.details: Successful missions raise the Bonus Multiplier, increasing the value of later scoring actions; multiplier pickups can also improve it. Build a reliable early sequence instead of treating every minor scoring opportunity as equally valuable. An arrest normally cuts the multiplier in half, so an unnecessary pursuit can make the remaining target much slower to reach. Compare the displayed score with the chapter target after each payout. You can finish the chapter without completing every phone and vehicle mission.

details_i18n.en: Successful missions raise the Bonus Multiplier, increasing the value of later scoring actions; multiplier pickups can also improve it. Build a reliable early sequence instead of treating every minor scoring opportunity as equally valuable. An arrest normally cuts the multiplier in half, so an unnecessary pursuit can make the remaining target much slower to reach. Compare the displayed score with the chapter target after each payout. You can finish the chapter without completing every phone and vehicle mission.
details_i18n.pt: Missões bem-sucedidas elevam o Bonus Multiplier, aumentando o valor das ações posteriores; itens de multiplicador também podem melhorá-lo. Construa uma sequência inicial confiável em vez de tratar toda pequena oportunidade como igualmente valiosa. Uma prisão normalmente corta o multiplicador pela metade; uma perseguição desnecessária pode tornar muito mais demorado alcançar a meta restante. Compare os pontos exibidos com o objetivo do capítulo após cada pagamento. É possível concluir o capítulo sem terminar todas as missões de telefones e veículos.

items.details: The original campaign does not provide a normal save-anywhere checkpoint between contracts. Chapter completion records your progress and unlocks the next stage, but a failed mission cannot simply be selected for another attempt within the same run. Losing all lives ends the attempt and forces a chapter restart. For the score route, recover by choosing another available source of points. For an all-missions personal goal, a single failed required contract means restarting that chapter attempt. Keep those two goals distinct.

details_i18n.en: The original campaign does not provide a normal save-anywhere checkpoint between contracts. Chapter completion records your progress and unlocks the next stage, but a failed mission cannot simply be selected for another attempt within the same run. Losing all lives ends the attempt and forces a chapter restart. For the score route, recover by choosing another available source of points. For an all-missions personal goal, a single failed required contract means restarting that chapter attempt. Keep those two goals distinct.
details_i18n.pt: A campanha original não oferece um ponto de salvamento comum a qualquer momento entre contratos. Concluir o capítulo registra o progresso e libera a etapa seguinte, mas uma missão fracassada não pode simplesmente ser escolhida de novo na mesma partida. Perder todas as vidas encerra a tentativa e exige reiniciar o capítulo. Na rota por pontuação, recupere-se escolhendo outra fonte disponível de pontos. Na meta pessoal de todas as missões, falhar num contrato necessário exige reiniciar aquela tentativa. Mantenha essas duas metas distintas.

items.details: In the original PC manual, being killed sends you to a hospital, costs a life and removes your weapons while retaining the Bonus Multiplier. An arrest sends you to a police station, removes equipment and normally halves the multiplier while clearing police attention. A Get Outta Jail Free Card protects against the normal arrest penalties. After either setback, inspect your actual inventory and nearby roads before taking another job. Do not assume a respawn restores the weapon a contract expects you to carry.

details_i18n.en: In the original PC manual, being killed sends you to a hospital, costs a life and removes your weapons while retaining the Bonus Multiplier. An arrest sends you to a police station, removes equipment and normally halves the multiplier while clearing police attention. A Get Outta Jail Free Card protects against the normal arrest penalties. After either setback, inspect your actual inventory and nearby roads before taking another job. Do not assume a respawn restores the weapon a contract expects you to carry.
details_i18n.pt: Segundo o manual original de PC, morrer leva ao hospital, consome uma vida e remove as armas, mas mantém o Bonus Multiplier. Ser preso leva à delegacia, remove o equipamento e normalmente reduz o multiplicador à metade enquanto encerra a perseguição. Um Get Outta Jail Free Card protege contra as penalidades normais da prisão. Após qualquer revés, confira o inventário real e as ruas próximas antes de aceitar outro trabalho. Não presuma que reaparecer devolva a arma exigida por um contrato.

items.details: After reaching one million points, read the new contact message and use its marker to find the final meeting in the Park district. Approach the actual alley entrance rather than driving directly toward the arrow through surrounding blocks. Finish the meeting scene to register completion and unlock Heist Almighty. If you are pursuing every optional contract, postpone this exit until your separate checklist is finished; reaching the score target is permission to leave, not proof that all jobs were completed.

details_i18n.en: After reaching one million points, read the new contact message and use its marker to find the final meeting in the Park district. Approach the actual alley entrance rather than driving directly toward the arrow through surrounding blocks. Finish the meeting scene to register completion and unlock Heist Almighty. If you are pursuing every optional contract, postpone this exit until your separate checklist is finished; reaching the score target is permission to leave, not proof that all jobs were completed.
details_i18n.pt: Depois de alcançar um milhão de pontos, leia a nova mensagem e use a marcação para encontrar o encontro final no bairro Park. Procure a entrada real do beco em vez de dirigir diretamente para a seta através dos quarteirões. Termine a cena do encontro para registrar a conclusão e liberar Heist Almighty. Se estiver buscando todos os contratos opcionais, adie a saída até terminar sua lista separada; atingir a meta permite sair, mas não comprova a conclusão de todos os trabalhos.

items.details: Liberty City routes are constrained by bridge approaches and elevated structures, so a target that looks close can require a longer road circuit. Check the starting district and destination before accelerating into an unfamiliar turn. On PC, trains offer another way across the city, but you must board and leave at stations; a moving train is not an immediate exit route to any point beneath its track. Preserve enough time for the walk from the arrival station to the actual objective.

details_i18n.en: Liberty City routes are constrained by bridge approaches and elevated structures, so a target that looks close can require a longer road circuit. Check the starting district and destination before accelerating into an unfamiliar turn. On PC, trains offer another way across the city, but you must board and leave at stations; a moving train is not an immediate exit route to any point beneath its track. Preserve enough time for the walk from the arrival station to the actual objective.
details_i18n.pt: As rotas de Liberty City dependem dos acessos às pontes e das estruturas elevadas; um alvo aparentemente próximo pode exigir uma volta maior pelas ruas. Confira o bairro inicial e o destino antes de acelerar numa curva desconhecida. No PC, os trens oferecem outra forma de atravessar a cidade, mas é preciso embarcar e sair nas estações; um trem em movimento não permite descer imediatamente em qualquer ponto sob os trilhos. Reserve tempo para caminhar da estação de chegada até o objetivo real.

items.details: The first phone set is in Central Market; the later North Sunview set becomes available after the initial Market mission chains have been attempted. A phone can continue into another segment automatically, so keep following its messages until that chain is resolved. If the later group is unavailable, inspect the initial phones for unfinished work instead of assuming your score is the unlock condition. Successful completion helps the multiplier, but the phone-group progression and the two-million-point level exit are separate checks.

details_i18n.en: The first phone set is in Central Market; the later North Sunview set becomes available after the initial Market mission chains have been attempted. A phone can continue into another segment automatically, so keep following its messages until that chain is resolved. If the later group is unavailable, inspect the initial phones for unfinished work instead of assuming your score is the unlock condition. Successful completion helps the multiplier, but the phone-group progression and the two-million-point level exit are separate checks.
details_i18n.pt: O primeiro conjunto de telefones fica em Central Market; o conjunto posterior de North Sunview aparece depois que as sequências iniciais de Market foram tentadas. Um telefone pode continuar automaticamente em outro segmento; siga as mensagens até resolver aquela sequência. Se o grupo posterior estiver indisponível, confira os telefones iniciais em busca de trabalho pendente em vez de presumir que a pontuação seja a condição de liberação. Concluir com sucesso ajuda o multiplicador, mas o avanço entre grupos e a saída de dois milhões são verificações separadas.

items.details: Rasta Blasta begins with an active introduction job. Resolve that job and any later active contract before expecting the ending marker to appear after five million points. If the score is already sufficient but there is no final marker, check the pager and current mission state first. Avoid answering another optional phone once you are ready to leave. Follow the final contact’s marker to the meeting and let its scene finish; the displayed score alone does not complete the campaign ending.

details_i18n.en: Rasta Blasta begins with an active introduction job. Resolve that job and any later active contract before expecting the ending marker to appear after five million points. If the score is already sufficient but there is no final marker, check the pager and current mission state first. Avoid answering another optional phone once you are ready to leave. Follow the final contact’s marker to the meeting and let its scene finish; the displayed score alone does not complete the campaign ending.
details_i18n.pt: Rasta Blasta começa com um trabalho introdutório ativo. Resolva esse trabalho e qualquer contrato posterior em andamento antes de esperar a marcação final após cinco milhões de pontos. Se os pontos bastarem, mas a marcação não aparecer, confira primeiro o pager e a missão atual. Evite atender outro telefone opcional quando já estiver pronto para sair. Siga a marcação do contato final até o encontro e deixe a cena terminar; a pontuação exibida, sozinha, não conclui o desfecho da campanha.

items.details: Entering the special Coach in Northeast Fort Law starts a bomb-bus contract. Read the briefing before moving into traffic: once the bomb condition is active, dropping below the required fifty miles per hour risks detonation. Choose broad roads and gentle bends, leave room for the bus’s slow turning and avoid tight alleys or stationary queues. Continue following the pager until the danger is explicitly resolved. Do not assume that reaching an approximate district or abandoning the bus counts as a successful delivery.

details_i18n.en: Entering the special Coach in Northeast Fort Law starts a bomb-bus contract. Read the briefing before moving into traffic: once the bomb condition is active, dropping below the required fifty miles per hour risks detonation. Choose broad roads and gentle bends, leave room for the bus’s slow turning and avoid tight alleys or stationary queues. Continue following the pager until the danger is explicitly resolved. Do not assume that reaching an approximate district or abandoning the bus counts as a successful delivery.
details_i18n.pt: Entrar no Coach especial de Northeast Fort Law inicia um contrato com um ônibus-bomba. Leia as instruções antes de entrar no trânsito: quando a condição da bomba estiver ativa, cair abaixo das cinquenta milhas por hora exigidas pode detoná-la. Escolha ruas largas e curvas suaves, reserve espaço para as curvas lentas do ônibus e evite becos ou filas paradas. Continue seguindo o pager até que o perigo seja explicitamente resolvido. Não presuma que chegar a um bairro aproximado ou abandonar o ônibus conte como entrega bem-sucedida.

items.details: Scout the surroundings before taking a Kill Frenzy pickup, because it starts a timed challenge with its own weapon and target conditions. Read the actual objective: some ask for a specified kind of target or damage rather than a generic number of kills. Plan a route to suitable traffic or enemies while keeping an escape lane open. Record successful completion separately from merely finding or activating the pickup; a chapter’s secrets counter is not a reliable substitute for your challenge-result checklist.

details_i18n.en: Scout the surroundings before taking a Kill Frenzy pickup, because it starts a timed challenge with its own weapon and target conditions. details_i18n.pt: Examine os arredores antes de pegar um Kill Frenzy, pois ele inicia um desafio cronometrado com condições próprias de arma e alvo. Registre o sucesso separadamente de apenas encontrar ou ativar o item; a contagem de segredos do capítulo não substitui de forma confiável sua lista de resultados dos desafios.

items.details: Train services operate in the original PC Liberty City and Vice City, not San Andreas. Approach a station and board a passenger carriage when the train has stopped, using the ordinary vehicle-entry control. You cannot leave between stations, so identify the useful arrival stop before boarding during a timed job. The PC-only Counthash and Itali missions involve the train system and are absent from PS1 along with its trains. Use a PC mission checklist when pursuing all ninety segments.

details_i18n.en: Train services operate in the original PC Liberty City and Vice City, not San Andreas. Approach a station and board a passenger carriage when the train has stopped, using the ordinary vehicle-entry control. You cannot leave between stations, so identify the useful arrival stop before boarding during a timed job. The PC-only Counthash and Itali missions involve the train system and are absent from PS1 along with its trains. Use a PC mission checklist when pursuing all ninety segments.
details_i18n.pt: Os trens funcionam em Liberty City e Vice City do PC original, não em San Andreas. Vá a uma estação e embarque num vagão de passageiros quando o trem parar, usando o comando comum de entrar em veículos. Não é possível sair entre estações; identifique uma parada útil antes de embarcar durante um trabalho cronometrado. As missões Counthash e Itali do PC envolvem o sistema ferroviário e não aparecem no PS1, que também não tem esses trens. Use uma lista de missões de PC ao buscar os noventa segmentos.
